performance_case.causal_mechanism: A post-shock effect is executable only after complete target evidence has been received, its diagnostic has been sealed and a Manager-visible decision exists; any fill must be strictly later and use a separately frozen point-in-time price. The t0-to-h24 discovery label therefore cannot itself be treated as achievable strategy PnL.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch audits only frozen static contracts and cannot inspect real post-activation outcomes or market data, select continuation or reversal, define a parent or strategy, change the h24 response, implement or register an adapter, compute an equity curve, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy, write canonical state or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Drawdown, underwater duration, holding age and terminal inventory remain MISSING_PROOF until a causal fill contract, matched-capital parent, fees, slippage and separate future evidence are frozen and evaluated.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded readiness audit prevents discovery-label leakage and incompatible DRA adapter reuse before implementation effort or candidate budget is spent. If a finite gap exists, it should identify exactly one additive pre-outcome capability slice and stop.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL. Its value is determining whether an honest strategy specification could be frozen after a future positive factor result without using information before availability, discovery data as OOS, or an incompatible parent and adapter.
